explanation_short: KNN model performs best with R² = 0.81717 and MSE = 0.012810. Top correlated features with HPR are VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate.
explanation_full: The KNN model outperforms other models with the highest R² score of 0.81717 and the lowest MSE of 0.012810. The top three features correlated with HPR are VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate, with correlation coefficients of 0.7984, 0.7827, and 0.7641, respectively. The incremental feature analysis shows that the model performance improves as the number of features increases, with the best performance achieved when all 11 features are used. The RF and XGBoost models also perform well, but with lower R² scores and higher MSE values compared to the KNN model.
